samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable parameters for bit width and depth.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset (active low).</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset (active low).</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">FIFO full flag.</output>
        <output id="rempty">FIFO empty flag.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH" value_type="integer">FIFO bit width (default: 8).</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH" value_type="integer">FIFO depth (default: 16).</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <signal id="wptr" type="reg" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Write pointer register.</signal>
        <signal id="rptr" type="reg" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Read pointer register.</signal>
        <signal id="wptr_buff" type="reg" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Buffer for write pointer register.</signal>
        <signal id="rptr_buff" type="reg" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Buffer for read pointer register.</signal>
        <signal id="wptr_syn" type="wire" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Synchronized write pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="rptr_syn" type="wire" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Synchronized read pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="wen" type="wire">Write enable signal.</signal>
        <signal id="ren" type="wire">Read enable signal.</signal>
        <signal id="waddr" type="wire" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Write address derived from write pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="raddr" type="wire" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))]:0">Read address derived from read pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="wdata_ram" type="wire" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Data input for RAM.</signal>
        <signal id="rdata_ram" type="wire" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Data output from RAM.</signal>
        
        <!-- Full condition: write pointer equals to read pointer's inverse MSB followed by its LSBs -->
        <assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)], rptr[($clog2(DEPTH))-1:0]});
        
        // Empty condition: write pointer equals to read pointer
        <assign rempty = (wptr == rptr);
        
        // Write and read address assignment
        <assign waddr = waddr_bin;
        <assign raddr = raddr_bin;
        <assign wdata_ram = wdata;
        <assign rdata_ram = rdata;
        
        // Synchronize read pointer to write clock domain
        <always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn)>
            if (~wrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Synchronize write pointer to read clock domain
        <always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn)>
            if (~rrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Write enable logic
        <assign wen = winc && !wfull;
        
        // Read enable logic
        <assign ren = rinc && !rempty;
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        <dual_port_RAM
            DEPTH = $clog2(DEPTH),
            WIDTH = WIDTH,
            id = "RAM"
            >
            
            <connection src="wclk" dst="wclk"/>      <!-- Clock port for write side of the RAM -->
            <connection src="rclk" dst="rclk"/>      <!-- Clock port for read side of the RAM -->
            <connection src="wen" dst="wenc"/>       <!-- Write enable port of the RAM -->
            <connection src="ren" dst="renc"/>       <!-- Read enable port of the RAM -->
            <connection src="wdata" dst="wdata"/>     <!-- Data input port of the RAM -->
            <connection src="rdata" dst="rdata_ram"/> <!-- Data output port of the RAM -->
            <connection src="waddr" dst="waddr"/>     <!-- Write address port of the RAM -->
            <connection src="raddr" dst="raddr"/>     <!-- Read address port of the RAM -->
            
        </dual_port_RAM>
        
        
        // Write Pointer Logic
        <always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn)>   
            if (~wrstn) begin
                wptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr <= (winc && !wfull) ? (wptr + 1) : wptr;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Read Pointer Logic
        <always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn))
            if (~rrstn) begin
                rptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr <= (rinc && !rempty) ? (rptr + 1) : rptr;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Binary-to-Gray code conversion for write pointer
        <assign waddr_bin = wptr ^ (wptr >> 1); 
        
        // Binary-to-Gray code conversion for read pointer
        <assign raddr_bin = rptr ^ (rptr >> 1); 
        
        // Gray-to-Binary code conversion for synchronized write pointer
        <assign wptr_syn[($clog2(DEPTH)):0] = ({1'b0,wptr_buff} >> 1) ^ wptr_buff; 
        
        // Gray-to-Binary code conversion for synchronized read pointer
        <assign rptr_syn[($clog2(DEPTH)):0] = ({1'b0,rptr_buff} >> 1) ^ rptr_buff;
    </implementation>
    
</module>
